“寻侨迹，传侨魂”是我们在闽江大学开展的社会实践项目。在这里，你可以走进展览馆，: Tracing Qiaopi Heritage is a fieldwork project at Minjiang University. In the exhibition, you can enlarge an original letter and examine the handwriting on the paper.
是项目的写信功能。写下想对家人说的话，便可生成一封侨批格式的家书。: turns the words you want to share with your family into a letter following the traditional qiaopi format.
（又称\"银信\"），是海外华侨通过民间机构寄回国内、 附带家书或简单附言的汇款: , also called yinxin or “silver letters,” were remittance receipts that overseas Chinese sent home through private agencies. They often carried a family letter or a short note. Widely used from the 1820s to the 1970s, the Qiaopi Archives were inscribed on UNESCO’s Memory of the World Register in June 2013.
侨批承载着海外华侨\"家书抵万金\"的深厚情感，体现了中华民族的孝道伦理、 亲情: For families separated by an ocean, a letter from home could be worth a fortune. Qiaopi bear witness to filial devotion, family ties and the trust that made remittances possible. Xi Jinping has described them as a record of earlier generations’ struggles to make a living overseas and their enduring love for family and homeland.

随着\"水客\"往返南洋与中国之间，最早的侨批形式出现。水客既带信又带钱，是侨批: Traveling couriers known as shuike carried both letters and money between Southeast Asia and China. Their journeys laid the foundations of the qiaopi system.
专业侨批局（民信局）开始在东南亚各地设立，形成覆盖南洋各埠的侨批网络。: Specialist agencies began opening across Southeast Asia, linking ports through a network for letters and remittances.
侨批局遍布东南亚各大城市，形成\"批脚—批局—侨眷\"的成熟跨国通信金融网络。: Agencies spread through major Southeast Asian cities. Couriers, agencies and families together formed a cross-border network for correspondence and payments.
抗战期间，侨批成为连接海外华侨与祖国的生命线，大量侨汇支持国内抗战和民生。: During the war against Japan, qiaopi became a lifeline between overseas Chinese and people at home. Remittances supported both the war effort and everyday expenses.
新中国成立后，侨批局逐步纳入国家邮政和银行体系，侨批转为银行汇款。: After the founding of the People’s Republic of China, the agencies were gradually incorporated into the national postal and banking systems. Bank transfers took the place of qiaopi.
侨批时代终结: The end of the qiaopi era
随着现代通信和银行系统普及，传统侨批完成历史使命，逐渐退出历史舞台。: As modern banking and communications became widely available, traditional qiaopi gradually fell out of use.
侨批档案正式入选联合国教科文组织《世界记忆名录》，成为全人类共同的文化遗产。: UNESCO inscribed the Qiaopi Archives on its Memory of the World Register, recognizing their significance as shared documentary heritage.
